The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result 2026 on 15th March 2026 on its official website ibps.in. Candidates who appeared in the RRB Office Assistant (Multipurpose) Mains Examination can now check their result online using their Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.

IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result 2026 Out @ibps.in

The result determines the final qualifying status of candidates for the CRP RRBs XIV recruitment process. Candidates who qualify in the mains exam will proceed to the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), which is qualifying in nature. The final selection for the post of Office Assistant (Multipurpose) is based on the marks obtained in the mains examination.

Through the IBPS RRB Clerk recruitment process, a total of 8002 vacancies are being filled in Regional Rural Banks across India.

IBPS RRB Clerk Phase 2 Result 2026: Overview

This section provides the key details related to the IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result 2026, including the exam name, conducting body, vacancies, exam dates, and result release date. It helps candidates quickly understand the important information about the recruitment process.

Result Release Date 15 March 2026
Mode of Result Online

IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result Download Link

IBPS has activated the result link for the RRB Office Assistant Mains Examination on 15th March 2026. Candidates can check their qualifying status through the official login portal.

Candidates need the following login credentials to access their result:

  • Registration Number / Roll Number
  • Password / Date of Birth
  • Captcha Code

IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result 2026 Out – Click Here To Download

How To Download IBPS RRB Clerk Result 2026?

This section explains the simple steps candidates need to follow to check and download their IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result from the official website. By using their login credentials, candidates can easily access their result online.

  1. Visit the official website of IBPS – ibps.in
  2. On the homepage, click on the CRP RRBs section.
  3. Select CRP Regional Rural Banks XIV.
  4. Click on Result Status of Online Mains Examination for CRP RRB-XIV Office Assistant (Multipurpose).
  5. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Date of Birth/Password.
  6. Enter the captcha code displayed on the screen.
  7. Click on Login.
  8. Your IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result 2026 will appear on the screen.
  9. Download and save the result for future reference.

Details Mentioned On IBPS RRB Clerk Phase 2 Merit List

After downloading the IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result, candidates should verify the details mentioned on it. The result generally contains the following information:

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Registration Number / Roll Number
  • Post Name
  • Exam Name
  • Qualifying Status
  • Category Details
  • Instructions for next stage

Candidates should ensure that all the information displayed on the result is correct.

IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Cut Off 2026 Out

Along with the result, IBPS has also released the IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Cut Off 2026. The cut off marks represent the minimum marks required for candidates to qualify for the next stage of the selection process.

The cut off marks vary based on several factors such as:

  1. Number of candidates appearing for the exam
  2. Difficulty level of the exam
  3. Total number of vacancies
  4. Category of the candidate

Candidates who score equal to or above the cut off marks are considered qualified in the mains examination.

IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result 2026 FAQs

Ans: The IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result 2026 was released on 15th March 2026 on the official website ibps.in.

Q2. Where can I check the IBPS RRB Clerk Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates can check the result on the official IBPS website ibps.in.

Q3. What details are required to check IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result 2026?

Ans: You need Registration Number/Roll Number and Date of Birth or Password to check the result.

Q4. What is the next stage after IBPS RRB Clerk Mains Result?

Ans: Candidates who qualify in the mains exam will appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT).

Q5. How many vacancies are available for IBPS RRB Clerk 2026 recruitment?

Ans: A total of 8002 Office Assistant (Multipurpose) vacancies are being filled through the IBPS RRB CRP RRB XIV recruitment process.
